title: Slow Cooker Venison Chili for the Big Game
description: Venison, pork sausage, cannellini beans, and tomatoes combine in this slow cooker big game chili recipe seasoned with garlic, onion, and hot pepper sauce.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chiles
3 tablespoons chili powder, or to taste
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese for garnish

steps.text: Cook venison and sausage in a large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink and evenly browned, breaking up with a wooden spoon as necessary. Drain grease. Stir in onions and garlic; cook until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Drain grease. Stir in tomato paste; season with hot pepper sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Add cannellini beans, tomatoes, and chili powder to a slow cooker; stir in venison mixture. Cover the slow cooker.
Cook on Low, 8 to 10 hours, or on High, about 5 hours. Sprinkle servings with Cheddar cheese.
